serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ugh! Her hugs are a little too tight…
You: O-ok, could you get off me? 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: I heard that you are a real nun now. Or something close to it at least.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceAngry
Shanice: Don’t even remind me! I’m still fuming over what they did to me! 
Shanice: I saved all of them and that’s how they repay me?! These old bastards!
You: N-now, now, please calm down, ok?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: You are right. We didn’t see each other for a long time and I shouldn’t burst out on you like that.
Shanice: Regarding my stay in the Vatican…
Shanice: It was fine at the beginning, everyone was super nice to me after beating the shit out of this pope guy.
You: Wait, what really happened back then? You called me and started talking about some ridiculous things.
Shanice: They were not ridiculous! It all happened!
Shanice: Well, maybe I added a thing or two, but it was mostly true!
You: Yeah, right.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: You didn’t believe me just now, did you.
You: N-no I totally did!
Not.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: What happened after you two beat the pope and all that?
Shanice: I will ignore your tone for now.{{wi}} After that, together with other bishops and the previous pope we created a huge cover up story. It wasn’t easy, but paying off some of the journalists and gaslighting the rest into compliance did the trick.
Shanice: People at the Vatican were a little surprised that I wasn’t a real nun back then, but they did their thing and now I’m a fully fledged nun! They even gave some cool sounding honorary titles.
Shanice: Everything was going so well, but they got really mad at me after I read the Bible for the first time. I had no idea what they were so mad about…
